title: Digital Edition of Filippo Cavriana's Correspondence
notes: The repository Pantagrueliste/CavrianaCorr (live 200) is a digital TEI edition of Filippo Cavriana's late-16th-century correspondence, described as 'Digital Edition of Filippo Cavriana's Correspondence'; licence CC BY 4.0. Matches the collected 2-text collection exactly. Origin verbatim: 'Cavriana correspondence (late 16th c)'. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: Pantagrueliste (research project on Cavriana correspondence), GitHub-hosted TEI edition
